fields.instructions: A side panel listing the article’s H2 headings (a dropdown on phones). Off — one centred text column. Card photo — the Featured image. Slider in the text: Add Media → Create gallery → “Display as: Slider”. Other inserts: [rts_cta title="…" button="…" url="…" size="big"], [rts_youtube url="…" image="ID"].
